title.en: No stable grid: which catalogue do you open?
title.zh: 没有稳定电网时打开哪一本目录？

description.en: Open the diesel catalogue. The off-grid page lists Diesel 30–120, LZ-60 / LZ-80, Tractor-Driven 4100 and the rural diesel pump.
description.zh: 打开柴油目录。无电网页面列出柴油30–120、LZ-60 / LZ-80、拖拉机带动4100和农村柴油泵。

h1.en: No stable grid: which catalogue do you open?
h1.zh: 没有稳定电网时打开哪一本目录？

directAnswer.en: The diesel catalogue. Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai prints the rule twice: the off-grid solution page and the selection guide. Rural houses, remote infrastructure and sites without stable electricity use diesel trailer pumps or tractor-driven units. The listed families are Diesel 30–120, LZ-60 / LZ-80, Tractor-Driven 4100 and the rural diesel pump. Electric 20–80 stay on the shelf until a real motor supply exists.
directAnswer.zh: 柴油目录。邢台河北品锦机械把这条规则写了两次：无电网应用页和选型指南。农村住宅、偏远基建和供电不稳的工地使用柴油拖泵或拖拉机带动泵。列出的系列是柴油30–120、LZ-60 / LZ-80、拖拉机带动4100和农村柴油泵。在真正的电机电源出现之前，电动20–80先放着。

heading.en: Split compact diesel from trailer diesel
heading.zh: 把紧凑柴油和拖式柴油分开

body.en: Compact: rural diesel 17 kW, 5–8 m³/h, 800 kg; tractor-driven 4100 at 40 kW, 6–12 m³/h, 1300 kg. Trailer: Diesel 30 at 2000 kg up to Diesel 120 at 8000 kg, plus LZ-60 at 5500 kg and LZ-80 at 6800 kg. A tight house plot starts at the compact pair. A long infrastructure line starts at the trailer whose distance cell covers the pipe.
body.zh: 紧凑：农村柴油泵 17 kW、5–8 m³/h、800 kg；拖拉机带动4100 为 40 kW、6–12 m³/h、1300 kg。拖式：柴油30为 2000 kg，直到柴油120为 8000 kg，加上 LZ-60 的 5500 kg 和 LZ-80 的 6800 kg。狭小住宅从紧凑这一对开始。长基建管路从距离格盖得住管子的那台拖泵开始。

heading.en: Spraying without 380 V is a third catalogue
heading.zh: 没有 380V 的喷涂是第三本目录

body.en: If the job is mortar or concrete spraying rather than pipeline placement, the off-grid spraying rows are Type 511 diesel (3 m³/h, 30 m / 15 m) and the diesel concrete sprayer (28/32 HP, 5 m³/h, 80 m / 40 m). They are not Diesel 30. The industrial-projects page is about diesel pumping, not forklifts or spiral feeders.
body.zh: 如果作业是砂浆或混凝土喷涂，而不是管道浇筑，无电网的喷涂行是 511 柴油机（3 m³/h、30 m / 15 m）和柴油混凝土喷涂机（28/32 HP、5 m³/h、80 m / 40 m）。它们不是柴油30。工业项目页讲的是柴油泵送，不是叉车或螺旋给料机。

heading.en: What should Xingtai receive with the inquiry?
heading.zh: 向邢台询盘要带上什么？

body.en: Say pipeline placement or spraying, then the power you do not have. Send Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai the mix, the largest stone or particle, the output you need, the horizontal and vertical pipe you measured, and whether the site has grid voltage or must use diesel. Use /contact, the on-site WhatsApp button, PinjinHebei@Outlook.com or 19912003025. Do not attach a project name, a country job or a daily volume the catalogue does not print.
body.zh: 请先说明是管道浇筑还是喷涂，再说你没有的那种电源。 请把配合比、最大石子或粒径、需要的输送量、量到的水平与垂直管路，以及现场是电网还是必须用柴油，发给邢台的河北品锦机械。途径是 /contact、站内 WhatsApp、PinjinHebei@Outlook.com 或 19912003025。不要附上目录里没有的项目名称、国家工程或日浇筑方量。

question.en: Is a generator an excuse to pick an electric pump?
question.zh: 发电机能当作选择电动泵的理由吗？

answer.en: Only if it can feed the printed motor. Otherwise stay on the diesel page and tell Xingtai the supply you actually have.
answer.zh: 只有它供得起已印的电机时才可以。否则留在柴油页，并告诉邢台你实际有的电源。

question.zh: “柴油30–120”是否包含中间每个数字？

answer.en: It means the published models Diesel 30, 40, 50, 60 and 120, plus the LZ and compact diesel pages named beside them. There is no Diesel 70 or Diesel 90 page.
answer.zh: 它指已公布的柴油30、40、50、60和120，加上旁边点名的 LZ 和紧凑柴油页。没有柴油70或柴油90页面。
